steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Roarrr!<i>
On the battlefield at the Rust, the roars of Corruptors pierce the air from every direction. Graves activates her power, struggling to control the enemies before her.

Confronted by the overwhelming horde of Corruptors, well-equipped contamination cleanup units, MBCC staff, and Sinners fight together in a coordinated effort, steadily pressing the Corruptors into a tightening encirclement.
Yet, for Graves, a novice to the battlefield, the circumstances appear far from promising...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: My eyes... can't keep track of everything... and my power... too slow to activate.
The Corruptors' howls resonate like mournful death knells, their grotesque faces looking even more terrifying in the dim light.
Having already subdued one Corruptor, another suddenly emerges from the shadows. Graves finds herself unable to concentrate on both.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: ...It's too late!
The Corruptor's claws are mere inches from Graves, her power still not taking effect on this one. She barely twists her body to the side, bracing herself for the inevitable impact...
Snap out of it! This is a battlefield!
Bang!
A bright red baseball bat delivers a powerful blow to the Corruptor's head, sending it spinning several times before slumping lifelessly to the ground, its body collapsing in a heap.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: You... new here? Name's Dolly. Stick behind if you're scared. Wouldn't want my bat to accidentally knock you into next week.
The Sinner before her shows a wide grin. Unlike Graves, Dolly shows not a trace of fear toward the Corruptors. Instead, she swings her bat powerfully through the air, winding up for her next strike.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: These disgusting freaks are ruining my view! I'll wipe out every last one! Come on, let's see how many pieces I can break you into!

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Like... THIS!
Even before her words fade, another Corruptor is sent hurtling through the air by the force of her bat, producing a dull thud as it crashes into the distance.
Immediately after, a burst of electricity lights up the surroundings as an arrow crackling with sparks shoots down from above, accurately piercing through the Corruptor's skull.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Oh dear, is our fiery little girl throwing another tantrum? Looks like you still need the invincible EMP to deliver the fatal blow! How's that for skill?
A flamboyant figure sporting a bow on her back emerges, a self-satisfied smirk dancing at the edge of her lips as she boldly juts her chin towards the Sinner brandishing the baseball bat.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Oh? You wanna talk big? Fine—my bat vs. your arrows. Let's find out who bleeds first!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Whoa whoa, I was just kidding! Point that bat at the enemies, crazy! We've still got the newbie watching us—hey, hey!
Retreating at lightning speed, she narrowly avoids Dolly's bat, comically shielding her rear end before pivoting towards Graves.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hey, first time on a mission? Relax—with the invincible me watching your back, these losers won't even know what hit 'em.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: ...Thank you both.
Graves's voice trembles with nervousness, but her tone carries genuine heartfelt gratitude.
After eliminating the Corruptors near Graves, Dolly and EMP return to their positions, playfully squabbling with each other along the way.

In the midst of the chaos, Graves grapples with her own power, striving to acclimate swiftly to the battlefield. Her abilities are potent, but the cadence of genuine combat proves to be quite a challenge for her.

Chaotic shouts and violent collisions echo across the battlefield. Graves's heart pounds frantically in her chest as she fumbles through each movement. Without her teammates' cover and support, she would certainly have been injured by now.
Graves's gaze drifts toward the front line, where ${PlayerName} is intently monitoring the battlefield, adjusting strategies and directing the combat operations.
The entire team executes the battle plan with clockwork precision, apparently unaffected by her mistakes.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Am I actually being helpful?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Then... what can I do?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since this is your first combat mission, just stay behind the team and provide mobile support.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't worry, I'll be close by.
You noticed the commotion around Graves earlier, but with EMP and Dolly there to help, you weren't concerned.
With the battlefield situation now stable, you temporarily leave the front line and make your way towards her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: How's it? Not as scary as you imagined, right?
Graves looks up, forcing an awkward smile, then gently smooths down your upturned collar.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Everyone's so good at this. I'm really grateful they helped me earlier.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I'm not much help... And I've been holding everyone back...
Her voice gradually fades into a whisper, tinged with self-reproach. Her gaze descends lower and lower, as if she yearns for the ground to swallow her whole.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Not at all. Every single person is a vital part of our fighting force.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They're all very grateful for your help.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hmm... Maybe a little bit.
Graves looks like a pitiful puppy with drooping ears, fidgeting awkwardly in place with nowhere to hide.
You quickly drop your mock-serious expression.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry, I was just teasing you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Teamwork isn't about fighting solo. Everyone has their own strengths and weaknesses.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Real teamwork means everyone focuses on their own tasks while also doing everything they can to protect their teammates.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So don't worry about burdening others. Victory comes only when everyone works together and supports each other.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Teammates... Yes, I have teammates now.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I'm not... alone anymore.
As Graves recalls the Sinners who just helped her and the friendly greetings she has received at the Bureau, a smile returns to her face.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief, multiple high-threat units just appeared, and the engagement zone's heating up fast!

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Team A's got no counters for this Corruptor variant. Their defenses are limited there...
Before Eugene can finish his report, a group of Corruptors with threatening power levels breaches the left flank of the encirclement, throwing the entire formation into disarray.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eugene, move your team to shore up the left flank now! I'm sending backup to plug that breach!
Before you can finish deploying the forces, a lightning-fast Corruptor vaults over a vigilant cleanup member. In the blink of an eye, it appears right beside you and leaps high into the air.

steps.speaker: Eugene
steps.content: Chief! Look out above—!
Eugene's alarmed shout comes through your communicator. Your heart plummets as you look up toward the sky, but before your eyes can even focus, a grotesque face fills your entire vision...
The Corruptor's massive body dives down from above, threatening to tear you apart the next second!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: At this distance...
Daowei
At the last possible moment, a sharp pain sears through your mind. Simultaneously, the Corruptor clutches its own head and unnaturally halts in mid-air, frozen in place.
A surge of intense emotions flood over from the other end of your shackles. You realize it's someone using their power!
A red figure springs up from beside you, creating a powerful gust of wind as they rocket towards the suspended Corruptor...

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Gaaah!!<i>
The Corruptor's form hurtles several meters through the air before violently crashing to the ground, sending clouds of dust and rubble billowing into the air.
You duck down, lowering your head to avoid the flying debris. Everything has happened in mere seconds, leaving you and everyone around you frozen in shock.
When you look up again, the person standing protectively in front of you is...
Graves remains on high alert, her eyes locked on the Corruptor, too focused to acknowledge your call.

Black winds swirl with dust around her. The Mania enveloping her body resonates with the contamination lingering in the Rust. Surges of Mania energy pulse through the air, converging into an oppressive force.

She stands amid the crimson haze, her shoulders rising and falling with each labored breath. Her once-porcelain skin blooms with splotches of red, the delicate fabric of her dress now a canvas of spreading stains of Mania.
Mania has twisted her delicate features into something feral. A rising tide of red spreads across her eyes, erasing their former composure and leaving only murderous intent and menace.
She stands before you, transformed into something almost monstrous—the same form you once witnessed in the castle.
Her condition is highly unstable, with the infection rate continuing to rise, but the shackles that bind her to you have not yet completely failed.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Roarrrr!!<i>
In mere seconds, the Corruptor that was knocked away has already regained its footing. It moves with frightening speed, the impact making the ground tremble and sending up clouds of dust.

Graves moves in unsettling ways you can't quite follow. Almost imperceptible waves of power ripple through the air, and suddenly the Corruptor stumbles, its limbs growing sluggish as if its senses are being suppressed by some unknown force.
Yet even with its movements restricted, the Corruptor continues to attack on pure instinct.

Though it can't control its body, its wildly flailing punches are enough to keep everyone at bay. Several times, those massive fists nearly touch Graves, missing her only to strike the ground with a thunderous impact.
Graves grows impatient. The shackles binding you together tremble as her emotions crash over you like a violent tide. Her skin has now turned completely red.
She furrows her brow, all her attention focused on ending this battle. Suddenly, the Corruptor's legs twist unnaturally like a puppet being forcibly pulled away from its intended path.

Mania surges around her, whipping up her hair and dress like a spectral wind. An overwhelming pressure descends over the battlefield, causing every Corruptor and team member within range to struggle for breath.
Finally, the Corruptor's resistance breaks. Its massive body freezes like a jammed gear, unable to move even an inch.
In stark contrast to the paralyzed Corruptor, Graves moves with fluid grace. Like a ghost, like a fish through water, she dances through the air toward her frozen prey.

Time seems to stand still as she descends, her face obscured by her veil. A dagger—appearing in her hand from nowhere—glides forward with gentle precision, skillfully slipping between bones to pierce the Corruptor's heart.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f>Gaaarrrggghh!!!<i>
Flesh tears as the Corruptor releases its final wail before going completely still. Graves twists her wrist, rending the wound wider until the dagger pierces straight through the enemy's chest.
The Corruptor crashes to the ground with a thunderous impact, and the oppressive weight of Mania instantly vanishes.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I won't let you harm...
Graves stands still, her gaze dark and intense. Slowly, she lifts her foot and then viciously stomps on the fallen Corruptor, again and again, until she's certain it's nothing but a lifeless corpse.
The battlefield falls silent.
You feel the weight of every stare—from the cleanup members, Bureau staff, and her fellow Sinners. No one approaches. No one speaks.
Finally sensing something amiss, Graves slowly turns around as if waking from a trance, searching for you among the crowd. The smile on her face freezes in place.
The very people who fought beside her just moments ago are now staring at her. With painful clarity, she realizes their gazes are nothing like before.
In a flash, these stares merge with the ones she has seen before—burning into her, searing holes through her very being.
These stares... It's as though they're looking at... a monster.
Could it be...?!
Graves looks down at her hands. Blood is still dripping from the dagger, and her hands—just like in her recurring nightmares—are tainted a bright red.

Now that she realizes everyone has seen her red-skinned monstrous form, terror floods through her. With practiced ease, she drops to the ground, drawing her knees to her chest, and curls into a tight ball.
Will they be afraid of her?
Will they laugh at her?
Will they throw stones at her?
Do they see her... as just another Corruptor? Another monster to be purged?
She buries her head forcefully into the crook of her arm, too afraid to look up.
Until a gentle breeze stirs around her, until the sound of leather shoes approaching reaches her ears, until Graves has exhausted every terrible consequence her mind can conjure.
The silence stretches, thick enough to choke on—then shatters as cheers erupt around her, catching her completely off guard.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Nice work, rookie! Straight through the Corruptor's heart! That was a perfect home run!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Holy hell! If I'd known you packed this much firepower, I'd have dragged you everywhere! Just imagine how invincible we'd look together—the invincible EMP with an ace like you!

In response to their cues, a chorus of admiration reaches Graves's ears. Bewildered, she raises her head just enough to peek through a small gap, and finds the team already moving, reinvigorated, charging toward the remaining Corruptors with newfound ferocity.

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Tch, these Corruptors are disgusting when they cluster. Let's move! Don't leave a single one alive!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Hell yeah! Now I'm amped! Since I'm stuck on this mission, I'm gonna make damn sure they remember me!
Dolly and EMP continue their usual rowdy banter, while what Graves considers earth-shattering seems to be just another moment in the mission to them.

steps.speaker: Staff A
steps.content: Chief, a heads-up about our one-Sinner army would've been nice. Could've left half the team at home!

steps.speaker: Cleanup Member
steps.content: No way we're getting shown up! Can't let MBCC steal all the glory—let's mop up the rest in one go!

No one seems to care that Graves looks different than before. There are no stones thrown her way, no hushed voices gossiping behind covered mouths, and certainly no one collapsing in terror at the sight of her.
You approach Graves, crouching down beside her as she remains curled up in confusion, and give her a reassuring pat.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: See? I told you. Even when you reveal your true self, they don't hate you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That was a close call. Thanks for the save.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You were unstoppable out there. Maybe Nightingale's right—I should step back and let you take center stage and shine.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Take center stage... and shine?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: If people saw the real me... they would run away screaming, wouldn't they?

steps.speaker: Dolly
steps.content: Nice work, rookie! Straight through the Corruptor's heart! That was a perfect home run!

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: No one wants to be friends with a monster. Not everyone is you, willing to stand by a monster's side.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Holy hell! If I'd known you packed this much firepower, I'd have dragged you everywhere! Just imagine how invincible we'd look together—the invincible EMP with an ace like you!

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I'm so scared. Can a monster like me really keep all this...? Do I really deserve to feel happy?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You really are a wonderful person, and you deserve everything you have right now.
You extend your hand, assisting Graves to her feet. Her dress is marred by contamination, blood, and mud, her veil in disarray, yet none of it can obscure the radiance that shines from within her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your dress got dirty because of me... again.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I've been watching you this whole fight. At first, you couldn't keep up—your eyes unsure, reactions just off—but then you gradually found your groove. You even protected me at a critical moment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I wasn't really sure about throwing you into battle this soon... But I worried the longer I waited, the more insecure you would grow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I were always by your side, then I would be your only source of security. That's no way to grow.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want you to connect with others—learn how teamwork feels, or that other people need you too. It's not just my recognition that matters... it's everyone's.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: But what if... I messed everything up?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Want the real truth? I've got a tiny selfish streak in this too.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I want everyone to know that this "bride" of mine who's newly joined the Bureau isn't just beautiful—she's also an incredibly powerful Sinner.
You glance toward the other Sinners locked in fierce combat in the distance, tilting your head up slightly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides... even if you make a mistake? That's why we're a team. I trust them to cover for any gaps.
Noticing that Graves still looks anxious, you lean close to her ear and whisper so only she can hear...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: See? No one is afraid of you. Nothing you worried about has happened, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Like I said, you are a wonderful person, and you deserve everything you have right now.
Your words linger in Graves's ears, causing a ticklish sensation while her heart pounds rapidly. Like magic, they dissolve the anxiety that has been weighing on her heart.
The gloom and fear on Graves's face vanish completely as she throws her arms around your neck, her voice brimming with excitement and joy.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I helped! That means I'm useful to you, right?
Emboldened by your approval, Graves abandons her fear and hesitation, unleashing her power as she charges toward every place that calls for her help.

Wherever Graves goes, Corruptors either stumble like marionettes—tripping over their own feet and crashing to the ground—or flail wildly at thin air as if they're hallucinating, completely losing control of their bodies.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Someone's getting a little too excited, huh?

Watching Graves dart enthusiastically across the battlefield, fueled by her newfound motivation, you decide not to interrupt her moment of glory and return to the front line to continue commanding the battle.
Thanks to Graves's exceptional performance, the Corruptors are eliminated far more quickly than expected.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Is this... the last one?
Having pushed herself to the limits, Graves is now completely depleted of energy. She wrestles to maintain her balance, her eyelids at war with gravity itself.
You notice her condition and rush to her side.
Seeing you approach, Graves musters what little strength she has left to wave at you.
But suddenly her world spins, and Graves feels herself tumbling—until a pair of warm arms swiftly catch her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you okay? Did you get hurt?

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: I'm fine... not hurt...

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Is the battle... over?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's over. Let the others handle the final cleanup.

steps.speaker: Graves
steps.content: Hehe, I was... helpful...
Graves closes her eyes, a guileless smile spreading across her face. You respond in agreement.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Helpful? You were vital. We couldn't have done it without you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Graves?
You give her a light shake, but she's dead weight in your arms. Uncertain if she has drifted off to sleep or lost consciousness, you quietly murmur a few resigned words under your breath.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Going full burnout on your first mission? You really went all out.
Her clothes are stained with blood and mud, yet her face radiates a contented smile as if she's fallen into the most pleasant of dreams.
